search_window.basis: Coverage since the prior hourly supplementary check; overlapping previous completion where appropriate to avoid a discovery gap.

focus_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting sole, last or full-service community grocery
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution after storm, flood, fire, outage or damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
Official SNAP, WIC, or other food-assistance interruptions with immediate access effects
queries: "only grocery store" closed fire October 14 2026 town
"last grocery store" shuts down community October 2026
"food bank" emergency distribution cancelled power outage October 2026
coverage_notes.result: No newly published and verified qualifying disruptions were discovered within the bounded hourly window. Search returns largely concerned historical incidents, routine food access material or store closures with other grocery alternatives.

coverage_notes.caveat: Web discovery and indexing are non-exhaustive. Publication dates from search results are not proof an incident occurred during the search window. Production collection remains authoritative; no approvals, publication or schedule changes.
